_comment: Provenance for skills-library/. Cloned 2026-06-16, resources/ lane added 2026-07-28. SHAs are the upstream commits the vendored copies were taken from. License 'none' = all-rights-reserved; vendored for private personal use in this private repo only - do not republish. Four arrays, one per physical concept: 'sources' = skill packs fully vendored (full source) under backlog/, promotable into .claude/skills/. 'resources' = non-skill external resources (apps, MCP servers, toolkits) fully evaluated via meta-skill-intake + meta-bake-it-in, recorded as a metadata-only RESOURCE.md under resources/<name>/ - never full-source-vendored, see skills-library/INDEX.md. 'candidates' = repos noted as maybe-interesting but not yet evaluated - nothing physical on disk for these. 'excluded' = looked at and rejected outright (not skills, sandbox/demo apps).

candidates.notes: macOS app by Farza Majeed: a Swift/Xcode app plus a Cloudflare Worker that proxies API keys. An on-screen AI teaching buddy that watches your screen, talks back (AssemblyAI speech-to-text + ElevenLabs voice), and points a cursor at UI elements; uses the Anthropic API. NOT a Claude Code skill - there is no SKILL.md to vendor, so it is tracked here as a reference/source to mine for a future skill idea (e.g. a screen-aware teaching / guided-walkthrough buddy as a viz or tool skill). To actually run it: clone OUTSIDE the AI-OS repo and follow its own CLAUDE.md (needs a Cloudflare Worker plus Anthropic/AssemblyAI/ElevenLabs keys, Xcode 15+, macOS 14.2+). Repo went source-frozen 2026-04-27 - the author keeps new work private; this open-source snapshot stays MIT.

candidates.notes: Claude Code workspace by Craig Hewitt (Castos) for producing long-form, SEO-optimized blog content end to end: research -> write -> optimize -> publish. Net-new value vs what is already here: 24 SEO slash commands (/research, /write, /optimize, /performance-review, plus the landing-* and research-* sets) + 11 SEO agents (seo-optimizer, meta-creator, internal-linker, keyword-mapper, cluster-strategist, content-analyzer, cro-analyst, headline-generator, editor, performance, landing-page-optimizer) + a Python data_sources layer (GA4, Search Console, DataForSEO, plus nltk/textstat scoring). Caveat: the 26 bundled skills largely DUPLICATE the coreyhaines marketing pack already in backlog/live (copywriting, content-strategy, email-sequence, seo-audit, schema-markup, programmatic-seo, pricing-strategy, social, paid-ads, marketing-ideas, marketing-psychology, etc.), so if vendored, take the commands + agents + data tooling and dedup the skills. To run: clone OUTSIDE the AI-OS repo, pip install data_sources/requirements.txt, and set GA4/GSC/DataForSEO + Anthropic keys (see its .env.example).

Single documentation-only skill: an interface-polish reviewer (concentric radius, optical alignment, shadow-vs-border, interruptible/enter/exit animations, tabular nums, text wrap, image outlines, scale-on-press, hit areas, icon stroke weight, motion restraint) with quick/full modes and a Block/Needs-changes/Approve verdict. Directory intact (SKILL.md links relative refs typography/surfaces/animations/icons/performance.md + agents/openai.yaml). Zero deps (no MCP/env/service). Complementary to live impeccable (broad UX/IA) and eng-implement (build). Live copy carries AI-OS mods: name matched to folder, tightened description + when_to_use, ## Context Needs added, em/en dashes stripped (voice rule). Backlog copy stays verbatim upstream.
